[[File:Massassi_Ceremonial_Armor.jpg|thumb|150px]]
'''Massassi ceremonial armor''' was a type of light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] suit that was used by the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] for rituals whose purposes had been long-forgotten. It was also highly effective on the battlefield, offering good protection with minimal burden.
